events.content:
Added a server rendered welcome page that schedules page view logging with Next.js `after()`, so analytics work runs after the response. The page is dynamic so each request gets logged.

The logger POSTs a `page_view` event to `ANALYTICS_ENDPOINT` when configured; otherwise it writes the event to the server console. See [app/page.tsx](/workspace/app/page.tsx) and [lib/analytics.ts](/workspace/lib/analytics.ts).

I didn’t run tests. `git diff --check` passed. `package.json` and `package-lock.json` also show workspace changes that I left untouched.
